# Let's fetch all habit tracking notes (IDs 11-34) and extract the good posture status.
# We'll collect data in a list of (date, practiced) tuples.
habit_data = []
for note_id in range(11, 35):
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id)
    # Check if it's a habit tracker note
    if 'habit-tracker' in note.get('tags', []):
        # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
        title = note['title']
        date_str = title.replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '').strip()
        # Parse content to find practiced_good_posture
        content = note['content']
        # Find the line with practiced_good_posture
        for line in content.split('\n'):
            if line.startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
                value = line.split(':')[1].strip()
                habit_data.append((date_str, value))
                break

print(f"Collected {len(habit_data)} habit notes")
print(habit_data)
